	<h1>  FOSDEM 2027 Dev Room Application Is In</h1>

	
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">One thing people have asked me over the last month is whether <a rel="tag" class="hashtag u-tag u-category" href="https://socialwebfoundation.org/tag/swf/">#SWF</a> will be organising the Social Web Devroom at <a rel="tag" class="hashtag u-tag u-category" href="https://socialwebfoundation.org/tag/fosdem2027/">#FOSDEM2027</a> . The answer is: fingers crossed! <br><br>We submitted the application to manage the devroom ahead of the October 4 deadline. We haven’t heard back yet; the announcements are scheduled for October 20, about a week from this writing.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If the dev room is accepted, we will put out the call for proposals soon after that — it has to be published by October 27.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We have been really lucky to have broad participation from volunteers and partner orgs in doing the organization for the last 2 events. It encompasses everything from soliciting applications, judging the entries, and building the schedule to MCing the event, helping people at the door, and watching the time for speakers. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you want to be part of that work, please let us know! It is much easier work if we spread it around.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">SWF is also <em>not</em> organising BOFs at FOSDEM. So, if you have something to discuss, please plan a BOF! </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">I really recommend coming to <a rel="mention" class="u-url mention" href="https://fosstodon.org/@fosdem">@fosdem</a>  if it’s affordable and convenient for you. It’s a great event. </p>
